description:
## Why

P-521 is rare in the wild — used in some government and high-assurance PKI deployments but not common in TLS. Filed for completeness.

OID: `1.2.840.10045.4.3.4` (ecdsa-with-SHA512).

## What

1. New `EcdsaP521Verifier` behind `feature = "p521"`. Mirror P-256/P-384 patterns.
2. Add `p521` to workspace deps.
3. OID dispatch in `DefaultVerifier`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Verifier impls `SignatureVerifier`.
- [ ] Unit tests against independent test vectors.
- [ ] `DefaultVerifier` dispatches.

## Filed as

PKIX-gphz child #5. Lowest priority of the crypto-coverage set; file as P3.

May discover that `p521` crate has different no_std posture or feature flags than p256/p384; document any divergence. If `p521` is not yet stable, may need to defer or use an alternative impl.
title: crypto: ECDSA P-521 + SHA-512 SignatureVerifier
